line: Last time: three things your agent still breaks on.
No memory. Login screens. No undo.
Here's the real fix for each one.
Memory: paste in what changed since last time.
Logins: tell it to stop and ask you. Don't guess.
Undo: make it show you a draft before it sends.
Paste in what changed, stop and ask on a login, show a draft before it sends.
Follow for setups that actually works.
